39108.commentary: (VINa) pakkhā jātā etesan'ti pakkhajātā. te lomapakkhā cammapakkhā aṭṭhipakkhā'ti tividhā. tattha morakukkuṭ'ādayo lomapakkhā, vagguli'ādayo cammapakkhā, bhamar'ādayo aṭṭhipakkhā'ti veditabbā. te sabbe'pi manussā ca pakkhajātā ca kevalaṃ idha dvipadaggahaṇena āgatā.

examples.text: ath'assa ratho samuddapiṭṭhena vegena gacchanto simbalivanaṃ pakkhanto, tassa gamanamagge simbalivanaṃ naḷavanaṃ viya chijjitvā chijjitvā samuddapiṭṭhe patati.

satthā ca me lokam'imaṃ adhiṭṭhahi, aniccato addhuvato asārato, pakkhanda maṃ citta jinassa sāsane, tārehi oghā mahatā suduttarā.

39124.commentary: (VINa) pakkhamānattaṃ nāma, yaṃ paṭicchannāya vā appaṭicchannāya vā āpattiyā addhamāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ diyyati.

39134.meaning1: is evident; is visible; is clear; is understandable

examples.text: yaṃ pana maṃ, bhante, bhagavā evam'āha, api ca, udāyi, tiṭṭhatu pubb'anto, tiṭṭhatu apar'anto, dhammaṃ te desessāmi, imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti, imass'uppādā idaṃ uppajjati, imasmiṃ asati idaṃ na hoti, imassa nirodhā idaṃ nirujjhatī'ti tañ'ca pana me bhiyyosomattāya na pakkhāyati.

39136.meaning2: having washed, having cleaned, having rinsed

examples.text: so ārāmagato nisīdati paññatte āsane. nisajja pāde pakkhāleti, na ca so bhavaṃ gotamo pādamaṇḍan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.

atha kho bhagavā bahu'd'eva rattiṃ abbhokāse nisajjāya vītināmetvā pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pāvisi. āyasmā'pi kho soṇo bahu'd'eva rattiṃ abbhokāse nisajjāya vītināmetvā pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
pāṭaligāmikā'pi kho upāsakā pāde pakkhāletvā āvasath'āgāraṃ pavisitvā puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya pacchim'ābhimukhā nisīdiṃsu, bhagavantaṃ'y'eva purakkhatvā.
nisajja kho bhagavā pāde pakkhālesi
nisīdi bhagavā paññatte āsane. nisajja pāde pakkhālesi.

sace, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, sambodhipakkhikānaṃ, āvuso, dhammānaṃ kā upanisā bhāvanāyā'ti, evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ kin'ti byākareyyāthā'ti?
byāpādavitakko, bhikkhave, andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.

examples.text: anāpatti samaye, dve tayo ekato bhuñjanti, piṇḍāya caritvā ekato sannipatitvā bhuñjanti, niccabhattaṃ, salākabhattaṃ, pakkhikaṃ, uposathikaṃ, pāṭipadikaṃ, pañca bhojanāni ṭhapetvā sabbattha anāpatti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

sutasannicayo'ti sutassa sannicayabhūto. yathā hi sutaṃ hadayamañjūsāya sannicitaṃ silāyaṃ lekhā viya, suvaṇṇaghaṭe pakkhittasīhavasā viya ca ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati, ayaṃ sutasannicayo nāma. dhātā'ti ṭhitā paguṇā.
so n'ātidūre n'āccāsanne āsanassa parivattati, na ca pāṇinā ālambitvā āsane nisīdati, na ca āsanasmiṃ kāyaṃ pakkhipati.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso garukaṃ silāguḷaṃ allamattikāpuñje pakkhipeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu taṃ garukaṃ silāguḷaṃ allamattikāpuñje labhetha otāran'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso loṇaphalaṃ paritte udakamallake pakkhipeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu taṃ parittaṃ udakaṃ amunā loṇaphalena loṇaṃ assa apeyyan'ti?
na bhuñjamānā sabbahatthaṃ mukhe pakkhipissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

examples.text: sīlavisuddhī'ti visuddhiṃ pāpetuṃ samatthaṃ catupārisuddhisīlaṃ. pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgan'ti parisuddhabhāvassa padhān'aṅgaṃ. cittavisuddhī'ti vipassanāya padaṭṭhānabhūtā aṭṭha paguṇasamāpattiyo. diṭṭhivisuddhī'ti sapaccayanāmarūpadassanaṃ.

39183.commentary: (KHPa) āsannasannivesavavatthitānaṃ rukkhānaṃ samūho vanaṃ, mūla-sāra-pheggu-taca-sākhā-palāsehi pavuddho gumbo pagumbo, vanassa, vane vā pagumbo vanappagumbo.

examples.text: vanappagumbe yatha phussit'agge, gimhānamāse paṭhamasmiṃ gimhe, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammavaraṃ adesayi, nibbānagāmiṃ paramaṃ hitāya, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

39184.meaning1: all the more; not to mention; even better

39189.commentary: (DNa) sujaṃ paggaṇhantānan'ti yaññayajan'atthāya sujaṃ gaṇhantesu brāhmaṇesu paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā'ti attho.

asantaṃ yo paggaṇhāti, asantaṃ c'ūpasevati, tam'eva ghāsaṃ kurute, byaggho sañjīvako yathā'ti.

39192.commentary: (ANa) paggaṇhe isinaṃ dhajan'ti abbhuggat'aṭṭhena navalok'uttaradhammo isīnaṃ dhajo nāma vuccati, tam'eva paggaṇheyya ukkhipeyya, uccaṃ katvā katheyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: bhāsaye jotaye dhammaṃ, paggaṇhe isinaṃ dhajaṃ, subhāsitadhajā isayo, dhammo hi isinaṃ dhajo'ti.

39193.meaning1: applies effort; strives on; goes for it; endeavours

examples.text: tvaṃ attano vīriyaṃ daḷhaṃ katvā paggaṇhā'ti bodhisattaṃ nānappakārāhi thutīhi abhitthuniṃsu.
uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati
evañ'ca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tath'eva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya

39195.meaning2: to make hold up; to cause to raise up; to make stretch out

39196.meaning2: held up, took up, supported, favoured, stretched forth

examples.text: ajapālarukkhamūlasmiṃ, nisīditvā tathāgato, tattha pāyāsaṃ paggayha, nerañjaram'upehiti.

39198.meaning2: having held up, having stretched forth

examples.text: na monena munī hoti, mūḷharūpo aviddasu, yo ca tulaṃ'va paggayha, varam'ādāya paṇḍito.
bhūtapubbaṃ pūraṇo kassapo bāhā paggayha kandanto na labhati, appasaddā bhonto hontu, mā bhonto saddam'akattha. n'ete, bhavante, pucchanti, amhe ete pucchanti, mayam'etesaṃ byākarissāmā'ti.
yo pana bhikkhu samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkameyya, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha tiṭṭheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evam'assa vacanīyo
so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evam'assa vacanīyo, m'āyasmā samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkami, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha aṭṭhāsi
